name: data-table
title: Data Table
description: An editable payments table with sorting, filtering, selection, visibility, and pagination.

motionProfile.reason: Committed sorting, filtering, visibility and data revisions move retained payments by one local box, newly inserted rows take a short opacity entrance, the bounded frame animates its committed shrink, and owned cell strings and quantities replace or roll in place.

feedback.press/one-shot.reason: Data Table mounts button for press feedback; that installed component remains the integration owner.

state.morph/one-shot.reason: Data Table mounts checkbox for local state/glyph feedback; that installed component remains the integration owner.
Data Table mounts dropdown-menu for this installed state.morph form; distinct component parts retain their own writers.

popup.anchored/one-shot.reason: Data Table mounts dropdown-menu for popup opening; that installed component remains the integration owner.

exit.fade/one-shot.reason: Data Table mounts button for its retained exit; that installed component remains an independent integration owner.
Data Table mounts dropdown-menu for popup closing; that installed component remains the integration owner.
Data Table mounts Table, whose surface-presence runtime implements the same retained exit form; Table remains that independent integration owner.

data.transition/one-shot.reason: A genuinely inserted payment row takes one opacity entrance on its own retained tr host; rows already visible at first paint and rows revisited by pagination take no entrance.
Data Table mounts button, whose migrated owner reaches this installed form inside the composition; button remains that independent integration owner.
Data Table mounts input, whose migrated owner reaches this installed form inside the composition; input remains that independent integration owner.
Data Table mounts checkbox, whose migrated owner reaches this installed form inside the composition; checkbox remains that independent integration owner.

layout.move/one-shot.reason: Retained visible payments move to their committed native boxes on the same tr hosts after a sort, filter, visibility or data revision; no cell, region or page replacement supplies a second transform owner.

geometry.resize/measured.reason: The bounded frame around the native table owns one measured block-size transition for a committed shrink; growth, a focused or pointer-held row and reduced/none resolve to native layout immediately.
Data Table mounts button, whose migrated owner reaches this installed form inside the composition; button remains that independent integration owner.
Data Table mounts dropdown-menu, whose migrated owner reaches this installed form inside the composition; dropdown-menu remains that independent integration owner.
Data Table mounts input, whose migrated owner reaches this installed form inside the composition; input remains that independent integration owner.

text.change/changed-runs.reason: Owned status and email cell strings replace only their changed graphemes on the retained cell host; Table delegates cell text to this caller, so no second text layer exists.
Data Table mounts button, whose migrated owner reaches this installed form inside the composition; button remains that independent integration owner.
Data Table mounts dropdown-menu, whose migrated owner reaches this installed form inside the composition; dropdown-menu remains that independent integration owner.

number.roll/reels.reason: Known payment amounts roll with the existing currency formatter and the selected count rolls on a known selection revision; the filter-derived result total and every query-derived count resolve directly.
Data Table mounts button, whose migrated owner reaches this installed form inside the composition; button remains that independent integration owner.
